In contrast, the Inventory Adjustment Form (00922237) is a financial control document that reconciles asset records, requiring approval from two hierarchical levels within related departments (Inventory Manager and Finance Department) to ensure accurate financial reporting. The visitor form controls future activity (planned visits) and physical movement, while the inventory form corrects past discrepancies and accounting records.
